# Magisk - Plus Key

A Magisk module that lets you choose what the Plus Key does. Pick a preset (assistant, camera, screenshot, flashlight) or run your own shell command.
## Install 1. Download the latest `pluskey.zip` from the [Releases](https://github.com/naplon74/magisk-pluskey/releases) page. 2. In the Magisk app, go to Modules > Install from storage and pick the zip. 3. Reboot. That's all you need. The key works with the default action (assistant) right after the reboot. You need a rooted phone with Magisk. ## Choosing what the key does Use the companion app (see below), or run this from a root shell: pluskey list pluskey set camera pluskey custom 'am start -a android.settings.SETTINGS' The change applies on the next key press, no reboot needed. ## Companion app There is a small app in `app/` with a settings screen and a Quick Settings tile. It only runs the `pluskey` command above, so the module works fine without it. Build it from source (see below) and install the APK. ## Tested on - OnePlus Nord 5 (CPH2709) - crDroid, Android 16 - Magisk Other phones and ROMs are untested. The module expects the Plus Key to report `BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY32` and the key layout to be at `/vendor/usr/keylayout/gpio-keys.kl`. ## How it works A systemless overlay removes the stock mapping for the key. A small root service listens for the key press and runs the action you chose. ## Build from source Module (needs `zip`): ./build.sh This writes `pluskey-.zip` in the repo root. App (needs JDK 17 or 21 and the Android SDK): cd app ./gradlew assembleDebug adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ## Credits Made by naplon74. Requires Magisk by topjohnwu.

Magisk - Plus Key

A Magisk module that lets you choose what the Plus Key does. Pick a preset (assistant, camera, screenshot, flashlight) or run your own shell command.

Install

  • Download the latest `pluskey.zip` from the [Releases](https://github.com/naplon74/magisk-pluskey/releases) page.
  • In the Magisk app, go to Modules > Install from storage and pick the zip.
  • Reboot.

    • That's all you need. The key works with the default action (assistant) right after the reboot.

    You need a rooted phone with Magisk.

    Choosing what the key does

    Use the companion app (see below), or run this from a root shell:

    pluskey list

    pluskey set camera

    pluskey custom 'am start -a android.settings.SETTINGS'

    The change applies on the next key press, no reboot needed.

    Companion app

    There is a small app in app/ with a settings screen and a Quick Settings tile. It only runs the pluskey command above, so the module works fine without it. Build it from source (see below) and install the APK.

    Tested on

  • OnePlus Nord 5 (CPH2709)
  • crDroid, Android 16
  • Magisk

    • Other phones and ROMs are untested. The module expects the Plus Key to report BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY32 and the key layout to be at /vendor/usr/keylayout/gpio-keys.kl.

    How it works

    A systemless overlay removes the stock mapping for the key. A small root service listens for the key press and runs the action you chose.

    Build from source

    Module (needs zip):

    ./build.sh

    This writes pluskey-.zip in the repo root.

    App (needs JDK 17 or 21 and the Android SDK):

    cd app

    ./gradlew assembleDebug

    adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

    Credits

    Made by naplon74. Requires Magisk by topjohnwu.
